name: ZX_REGIMES_B_
description: This table stores tax regimes and the related attributes. There will be one row per distinct tax regime. There are default entry columns to facilitate data entry process.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code

columns.name: PARENT_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Parent regime code for this regime

columns.name: HAS_SUB_REGIME_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this regime is a parent regime with one or more child regimes defined under it

columns.name: COUNTRY_OR_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether this regime is defined for a country or for a group of countries

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code for which this regime is defined

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_TYPE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate geography type of the group of countries for which this regime is defined

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective from date

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective to date

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Exchange rate type for transaction currency to tax currency conversion

columns.name: TAX_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Tax currency code

columns.name: CONV_ROUNDING_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the currency types for which rounded tax amounts in transaction currency will be used for currency conversion. Possible values are 'Functional Currency', 'Tax Currency' and 'Both'. If no value is specified, unrounded tax amounts in transaction currency will be used to calculate the tax amounts in both Functional and Tax Currency.

columns.name: THRSHLD_GROUPING_LVL_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate grouping level for applying thresholds across or within documents or lines or calendar periods

columns.name: ROUNDING_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Rounding rule code to be used for rounding taxes of this regime. Possible values are UP, DOWN and NEAREST.

columns.name: TAX_PRECISION
columns.description: Tax currency precision

columns.name: MINIMUM_ACCOUNTABLE_UNIT
columns.description: Tax currency minimum accountable unit

columns.name: TAX_STATUS_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined for taxes of this regime to determine tax status. This setting can be overriden at the tax level.

columns.name: DEF_PLACE_OF_SUPPLY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Default place of supply type for this regime

columns.name: APPLICABILITY_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined for this regime to determine tax applicability

columns.name: PLACE_OF_SUPPLY_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined for taxes of this regime to determine place of supply type. This setting can be overriden at the tax level.

columns.name: TAX_CALC_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined for taxes of this regime to calculate tax amount. This setting can be overriden at the tax level.

columns.name: TAXABLE_BASIS_THRSHLD_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether taxable basis threshold is applicable for this regime

columns.name: TAX_RATE_THRSHLD_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether tax rate threshold is applicable for this regime

columns.name: TAX_AMT_THRSHLD_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether tax amount threshold is applicable for this regime

columns.name: TAX_RATE_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined for taxes of this regime to determine tax rate. This setting can be overriden at the tax level.

columns.name: TAXABLE_BASIS_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined for taxes of this regime to determine taxable basis. This setting can be overriden at the tax level.

columns.name: DEF_INCLUSIVE_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether all the tax types within this regime are tax inclusive by default

columns.name: HAS_OTHER_JURISDICTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether taxes of this regime can have more than one jurisdiction

columns.name: ALLOW_ROUNDING_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the rounding rules can be overridden for taxes of this regime

columns.name: ALLOW_EXEMPTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether exemptions are allowed for this tax regime

columns.name: ALLOW_EXCEPTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether exceptions are allowed for this tax regime

columns.name: ALLOW_RECOVERABILITY_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether taxes of this regime are recoverable

columns.name: AUTO_PRVN_FLAG
columns.description: Not currently used

columns.name: HAS_TAX_DET_DATE_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Not currently used

columns.name: HAS_EXCH_RATE_DATE_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Not currently used

columns.name: HAS_TAX_POINT_DATE_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Not currently used

columns.name: USE_LEGAL_MSG_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether legal messages are applicable for this regime

columns.name: REGN_NUM_SAME_AS_LE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the registration number of the tax registration for this regime should be same as the legal entity registration number

columns.name: DEF_REC_SETTLEMENT_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether an input tax can be recovered when an invoice is recorded or only when the invoice is paid and whether an output tax is due for settlement when the invoice is issued or only when the payment is received against it.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_LOGIN_ID
columns.description: Login user identifier of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: DEF_REGISTR_PARTY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate default registration party type for taxes of this regime

columns.name: REGISTRATION_TYPE_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined for taxes of this regime to determine registration party type. This setting can be overriden at the tax level.

columns.name: TAX_INCLUSIVE_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the tax inclusive flag can be overridden at tax line

columns.name: REGIME_PRECEDENCE
columns.description: Column to indicate the precedence level at which taxes of this regime are determined when taxes are compounded across regimes

columns.name: CROSS_REGIME_COMPOUNDING_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether cross regime compounding is allowed for this regime

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Geography Id of the group of countries for which this regime is defined

columns.name: THRSHLD_CHK_TMPLT_CODE
columns.description: Determining factor template to be used for sub-grouping of total thresholds

columns.name: PERIOD_SET_NAME
columns.description: Accounting calendar name

columns.name: REP_TAX_AUTHORITY_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for the tax authority to whom all taxes under this regime are reported

columns.name: COLL_TAX_AUTHORITY_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for the tax authority to whom all taxes under this regime are remitted

columns.name: TAX_ACCOUNT_PRECEDENCE_CODE
columns.description: Column to store lowest level used to define tax accounts for this regime

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Program name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Application name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: USE_TAX_REPORT_CONFIG_FLAG
columns.description: Use Tax Reporting Configuration Flag

columns.name: REGIME_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the type of regime. Possible values are W (withholding), I (indirect) and NULL (indirect).

columns.name: VALIDATION_TYPE
columns.description: Reporting type defined for registration number validation.

columns.name: VALIDATION_LEVEL
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether validation is based on an error or a warning.

columns.name: UNIQUENESS_VALIDATION_LEVEL
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether validation is for all parties or a specific party.

columns.name: EXEMPTION_PROCESS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether exemptions are defined for customer, supplier, or both.

columns.name: BUCKET_LEVEL_FLAG
columns.description: Level at which withholding tax buckets are maintained. Possible values are L for legal entity and B for business unit.

columns.name: USE_SYSTEM_DEFAULTS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that application default values of tax status, rate, recovery rate, taxable basis formula, or tax calculation formula are used in tax calculation when an incomplete or inconsistent configuration is found.

columns.name: GROSS_NET_FLAG
columns.description: Apply regime on the gross or net amount on retainage indicator.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
